body: Teaches a fine-tuned checkpoint to natively produce the house transform (squish/tower/gematria). New cmd/towerprint-cli -- Python shells out to it rather than reimplementing pkg/towerprint's logic, one source of truth. New --towerprint-augment flag in prime_directive_dataset.py: deterministic sha256-keyed sampling (not Python's randomized hash()), 5% default fraction per the item's own instruction to decide and document it rather than default to 100%. 4 Go tests + 10 Python tests, full suite 65/65 + 4/4 green. Verified end-to-end: 347 real {text}->{tower} pairs generated from a 20% sample against the live corpus, 0 skipped, inspected output confirms correct pairing. Commit 00da185.
title: S150-01: towerprint-augmented training records
